user.title: Connect to the Email MCP add-on
user.description: The add-on must already be running. Use its internal address and the bearer token from the add-on's Configuration tab.

data_description.url: Usually http://ba3d2a6a-email-mcp:9560. A local add-on copy uses http://local-email-mcp:9560. Do not publish that port on your network.
data_description.token: The bearer token from the add-on Configuration tab. Leave the add-on token blank on first start and it will fill one in for you.

reconfigure.title: Update Email MCP add-on connection
reconfigure.description: Change the add-on address or bearer token. The webhook address stays the same.

data_description.url: Usually http://ba3d2a6a-email-mcp:9560. A local add-on copy uses http://local-email-mcp:9560.
data_description.token: Paste the current bearer token from the add-on Configuration tab.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on's MCP endpoint (is the add-on running? is the URL right?)
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the bearer token
error.invalid_url: URL must start with http:// or https://

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Email MCP Bridge can be configured

init.title: Email MCP connector URLs (secret, do not share)

data.cloudhook_inject_token: Cloud webhook: accept requests without Authorization (the address is the secret)

data_description.cloudhook_inject_token: Applies only to the cloud webhook. Leave this off unless your client cannot send an Authorization header there.
